name: ISF Group Berhad
overview: ISF Group Berhad 于2026年1月在马来西亚交易所 ACE Market 上市，首次公开募股（IPO）发行185,299,000股新股。公司业务线包括管道供应与安装、管道维护与维修、以及物业与基础设施项目，但公告中未披露各业务板块的具体变化。
overview_en: ISF Group Berhad listed on the ACE Market of Bursa Malaysia in January 2026, with an initial public offering (IPO) of 185,299,000 new shares. The company's business lines include piping supply and installation, piping maintenance and repair, and property and infrastructure projects, but the announcements do not disclose specific changes in each business segment.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 公司于2026年1月完成首次公开募股并在ACE Market上市。
segments.note_en: The company completed its initial public offering and listed on the ACE Market in January 2026.

actions.title: INITIAL PUBLIC OFFERING ("IPO") IN CONJUNCTION WITH THE LISTING OF ISF GROUP BERHAD ("ISF" OR "COMPANY") ON THE ACE MARKET OF BURSA MALAYSIA
actions.text: 公司进行首次公开募股，公开发行185,299,000股新股，并在马来西亚交易所ACE Market上市。
actions.text_en: The company conducted an initial public offering of 185,299,000 new shares and listed on the ACE Market of Bursa Malaysia Securities Berhad.
